Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to follow the Planner’s explicit instruction to locate and extract the “Died” field from the Wikipedia infobox and to open IMDb for cross-checking. Instead, it only loaded the Wikipedia page without scrolling or finding the infobox and never opened the IMDb page, then repeatedly reverted to DuckDuckGo snippets (which were conflicting). This lack of proper verification and cross-referencing prevented confirming the correct place of death (Nice) and propagated ambiguity, directly leading toward an incorrect or unresolved solution.
